::: {.reference-list}
1. IRI Data Library. *SubX EMC GEFSv12_CPC* (hindcast and forecast precipitation). <https://iridl.ldeo.columbia.edu/SOURCES/.Models/.SubX/.EMC/.GEFSv12_CPC/> Browsing Data Library pages requires signing in (checked 10 November 2026); PyCPT's data requests in this tutorial succeeded without a key.
2. Guan, H., Zhu, Y., Sinsky, E., et al. (2022). GEFSv12 reforecast dataset for supporting subseasonal and hydrometeorological applications. *Monthly Weather Review*, 150(3), 647-665. <https://doi.org/10.1175/MWR-D-21-0245.1>
3. BMKG. *Peringatan Dini Curah Hujan Dasarian* (dekadal rainfall early warnings by regency and city; showed dasarian I November 2026 when checked on 10 November 2026). <https://www.bmkg.go.id/iklim/peringatan-dini-hujan-tinggi>
4. Climate Hazards Center, UC Santa Barbara. *CHIRPS: Rainfall Estimates from Rain Gauge and Satellite Observations* (CHIRPS version 3.0 page). <https://www.chc.ucsb.edu/data/chirps3>
5. Funk, C., Peterson, P., Landsfeld, M., et al. (2014). *A quasi-global precipitation time series for drought monitoring*. U.S. Geological Survey Data Series 832. <https://doi.org/10.3133/ds832>
6. Climate Hazards Center. *Information about CHIRPS Daily Precipitation* (CHIRPS v3.0 daily readme). <https://data.chc.ucsb.edu/products/CHIRPS/v3.0/daily/readme.txt>
7. IRI. *PyCPT 2.10.4 source: `pycpt/src/pycpt/notebook.py`* (`setup`, `download_data`, `summarize_available_years`, `evaluate_models` and the plotting functions). Tag pycpt-2.10.4, commit 084bb5c. <https://github.com/iri-pycpt/pycpt/blob/084bb5c380c200b5f65f11ba224a965547b91da1/pycpt/src/pycpt/notebook.py>
8. IRI. *PyCPT 2.10.4 source: `pycpt/src/cptcore/functional/cca.py`* (`canonical_correlation_analysis`). Tag pycpt-2.10.4, commit 084bb5c. <https://github.com/iri-pycpt/pycpt/blob/084bb5c380c200b5f65f11ba224a965547b91da1/pycpt/src/cptcore/functional/cca.py>
9. IRI. *PyCPT 2.10.4 source: `pycpt/src/cptextras/redate.py`* (`redate`). Tag pycpt-2.10.4, commit 084bb5c. <https://github.com/iri-pycpt/pycpt/blob/084bb5c380c200b5f65f11ba224a965547b91da1/pycpt/src/cptextras/redate.py>
10. Mason, S. J., and Weigel, A. P. (2009). A generic forecast verification framework for administrative purposes. *Monthly Weather Review*, 137(1), 331-349. <https://doi.org/10.1175/2008MWR2553.1>
11. Epstein, E. S. (1969). A scoring system for probability forecasts of ranked categories. *Journal of Applied Meteorology*, 8(6), 985-987. <https://doi.org/10.1175/1520-0450(1969)008%3C0985:ASSFPF%3E2.0.CO;2>
12. Barnston, A. G., and van den Dool, H. M. (1993). A degeneracy in cross-validated skill in regression-based forecasts. *Journal of Climate*, 6(5), 963-977. <https://doi.org/10.1175/1520-0442(1993)006%3C0963:ADICVS%3E2.0.CO;2>
:::
